items.title: Gene Bertoncini interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming in New York City for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive at the IAJE festival. I’m pleased to have Gene Bertoncini for my guest this morning.

ctx.x: Gene was interviewed in New York City on January 13, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming in New York City for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive at the IAJE festival. I’m pleased to have Gene Bertoncini for my guest this morning. And I think we’re both a little dazed by all the music and the activity going on.
It’s a tremendous event. I think there are about seven thousand people here.
